goal: Consume the sender-side database preview classification and make no-preview routing explicit, exact-input-bound, deterministic, target-bound, and fail closed before claim or review admission.
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, marker, issue #2714, or pull request #2738 mutation.
No trust in a self-declared no-preview decision without an independently supplied exact file set, target identity, and matching content digests.
assumptions: The ai-devops sender contract is interface context only and remains owned by its existing worker.
NO_DATABASE_PREVIEW returns work to its natural owner before claim, review, or preview reads; all database-impacting or unverifiable classifications retain governed database admission.
stop_conditions: Exact target, file-set, or content-digest binding cannot be independently verified.
The change would require any prohibited mutation or weaken an existing database safety gate.
